name: playrunner
description: Build and run testing workflows on Playrunner Cloud or a configured self-hosted server.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Playrunner Cloud or your own Playrunner server. Inspect workflows and execution results, author workflows, and run tests using the capabilities exposed by the selected server. Cloud uses OAuth; self-hosted connections use a securely configured API-token environment reference, or OAuth when supported. Named server connections can be installed side by side. Browser authentication, environments and GitHub setup depend on the connected server capabilities. Test completion is reported separately from passing test evidence.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my Playrunner server and list its workflows.
Connect GitHub and configure an Authentication Profile for my tests.
Run my Playrunner workflow and explain any failures.
